messages.content: After transferring to a new school, Amy made 20 more friends than Lily. If Lily made 50 friends, how many friends do Lily and Amy have together?

content.text:
Amy made 50 + 20 = 70 friends.
Together, Lily and Amy have 50 + 70 = **120 friends**.
